The department office confirms all four events are on for next week and unchanged, but they can't tell me what I personally have to attend — they don't keep individual obligations. So leave them out of CALENDAR.md for now; I'll ask the staff who run those events and get back to you.

If you'd rather have it out of the file altogether, say the word and I'll delete that block; otherwise I'll leave it as the reference you asked for and wait for your word on the four events.

Understood: reference block stays, the four official events stay out of your week and marked unresolved — I won't act on them or treat them as settled. Nothing else from me; ping me whenever you know more or want anything else.
